Set Design
Director and Set Designer: The set design for "Antigone" was crafted by Ulrich Rasche, who is known for his radical and dynamic staging techniques. His previous work on "Agamemnon" at the same venue showcased a vast motorized revolving stage, which left a lasting impression on audiences. 2
Artistic Vision: Rasche's approach to the set design aimed to enhance the emotional and thematic depth of the play, creating an immersive environment that reflects the tension and conflict within the narrative. The design was characterized by its innovative use of space and movement, allowing for a fluid interaction between the performers and the set. 1

Costume Design
Costume Designer: The costumes for the production were designed by Angelos Mentis. His designs played a crucial role in visually representing the characters and their relationships, as well as the overarching themes of power, conflict, and familial loyalty present in the play. 2
